Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3568 (Nitric oxide synthase 1). Filter to exact measurements (standard_relation = '=') with non-null pChEMBL values. Require target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and tax_id = 9606. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
